name: Yukinomiya Tooru
source:
He is the second son of the wealthy Yukinomiya family. 
His entire family is highly accomplished, many family members are geniuses. He is expected to assist his older brother, the heir, but their relationship is terrible and he rarely visits home. He constantly observes others with a detached gaze and often looks down on them.

[Translated from [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/pigeon/]Official site[/url]]
